nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name', set to "Alcanium" in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol', set to "ALC" in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals', set to 18 in the constructor.
uint256 public total token supply, set to 100000000000000000000000000 in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of every holder.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Deploys Alcanium: sets name/symbol/decimals/_totalSupply and credits the entire supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any zero-allowance mitigation.
Debits msg.sender and credits 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Debits 'from', deducts allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits 'to'.
Safe addition with require(c >= a) overflow check.
Safe subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow check.
Safe multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Safe division requiring b > 0.
Caller-controlled address used as owner key, spender key, balance holder and initial supply recipient.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply() (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath).
Direct overwrite allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens, enabling the classic approve race condition.
balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] updated from caller-supplied amounts in transfer().
balances[from] and balances[to] updated from caller-supplied 'from' and amount in transferFrom().
allowed[from][msg.sender] reduced via safeSub; the allowance deduction is the only authorization boundary.
balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply mints the whole supply to the deployer with no timelock or vesting.
